channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brittney Griner | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brittney Griner from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Brittney Griner
item.description:
Dwane Casey on Brittney Griner's release:

“I definitely wanted to say how happy myself, the organization, our family is about Brittney Griner being freed from her situation. Back in the states, back at home, back with her family, it's a blessing.”

Dwane Casey on Brittney Griner, Dec 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Brittney Griner
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Brittney Griner:

“It was a moment of celebration and a great point of perspective for all of us. ... Incredible that this is happening, that she can go home and resume her life.”

Erik Spoelstra on Brittney Griner, Dec 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Adam Silver on Brittney Griner
item.description:
Adam Silver:

“Brittney has had to endure an unimaginable situation and we’re thrilled that she is on her way home to her family and friends. We thank the members of the NBA & WNBA community who never wavered in their efforts to raise awareness of Brittney's unjust circumstances.”

Adam Silver on Brittney Griner, Dec 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Brittney Griner
item.description:
Chauncey Billups:

“I woke up this morning with a big smile on my face at the news that Brittney Griner is coming home.… I mainly want to give a shoutout to the WNBA. They didn’t let a day go by without screaming ‘Free BG.’”

Chauncey Billups on Brittney Griner, Dec 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Adam Silver on Brittney Griner
item.description:
NBA CommissionerAdam Silver on Brittney Griner:

“We are working in lock step with the US government and outside experts trying to expedite her release in any way we can. Certainly, our hearts go out to her and her family.”

Adam Silver on Brittney Griner, Jun 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: David Stern on Brittney Griner
item.description:
Brian Mahoney:Stern, last Thu on when NBA had gay player.

“We'd like everything to get the same attention that Britney Griner got, which was very little.”

David Stern on Brittney Griner, Apr 29, 2013. Source: Twitter @briancmahoney.

item.title: Shane Battier on Brittney Griner
item.description:
In terms of the first woman to play in the NBA, is Griner the one?

“I don't know if it's Griner or if it's someone who is 5 years old right now,”

Shane Battier on Brittney Griner, Apr 5, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Geno Auriemma on Brittney Griner
item.description:
“If Brittney Griner tries to make it to an NBA team, I think it would be a public relations thing,”

Geno Auriemma on Brittney Griner, Apr 4, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.
